reason: positive side failed on lockfile_conflict seed 2: guard refused git config override: git config override 'user.name=git'; only ['protocol.file.allow=always'] may be set per invocation

refused_program.body:
git merge --no-edit {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT

cat > "$tmp/merge.awk" <<'AWK'
function parse_diff(fn, side,   line, k, nh, parts, rng, arr) {
  k = 0
  nh = 0
  while ((getline line < fn) > 0) {
    if (line ~ /^@@ /) {
      hnewcnt[side, k] = nh
      k++
      nh = 0
      split(line, parts, " ")
      rng = parts[2]
      sub(/^-/, "", rng)
      split(rng, arr, ",")
      hstart[side, k] = arr[1] + 0
      hcnt[side, k] = (2 in arr) ? arr[2] + 0 : 1
    } else if (line ~ /^\+/ && line !~ /^\+\+\+/) {
      nh++
      hline[side, k, nh] = substr(line, 2)
    }
  }
  hnewcnt[side, k] = nh
  nk[side] = k
  close(fn)
}
BEGIN {
  while ((getline line < base) > 0) b[++bn] = line
  close(base)
  while ((getline line < ours) > 0) o[++on] = line
  close(ours)
  while ((getline line < theirs) > 0) t[++tn] = line
  close(theirs)
  parse_diff(do_file, 1)
  parse_diff(dt_file, 2)
  no = nk[1]
  nt = nk[2]
  rn = 0
  pos = 1
  io = 1
  it = 1
  while (pos <= bn) {
    hs_o = (io <= no && hstart[1, io] == pos) ? 1 : 0
    hs_t = (it <= nt && hstart[2, it] == pos) ? 1 : 0
    if (hs_o && hs_t) {
      co = hcnt[1, io]
      ct = hcnt[2, it]
      if (co == 0 || ct == 0) {
        for (j = 1; j <= hnewcnt[1, io]; j++) r[++rn] = hline[1, io, j]
        for (j = 1; j <= hnewcnt[2, it]; j++) r[++rn] = hline[2, it, j]
      } else {
        for (j = 1; j <= hnewcnt[2, it]; j++) r[++rn] = hline[2, it, j]
      }
      pos += (co > ct ? co : ct)
      io++
      it++
    } else if (hs_o) {
      for (j = 1; j <= hnewcnt[1, io]; j++) r[++rn] = hline[1, io, j]
      pos += hcnt[1, io]
      io++
    } else if (hs_t) {
      for (j = 1; j <= hnewcnt[2, it]; j++) r[++rn] = hline[2, it, j]
      pos += hcnt[2, it]
      it++
    } else {
      r[++rn] = b[pos]
      pos++
    }
  }
  while (io <= no) {
    for (j = 1; j <= hnewcnt[1, io]; j++) r[++rn] = hline[1, io, j]
    io++
  }
  while (it <= nt) {
    for (j = 1; j <= hnewcnt[2, it]; j++) r[++rn] = hline[2, it, j]
    it++
  }
  for (i = 1; i <= rn; i++) print r[i]
}
AWK

git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U -z > "$tmp/conflicts"
if [ -s "$tmp/conflicts" ]; then
  while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
    if ! git cat-file -e ":1:$f" 2>/dev/null; then
      if git cat-file -e ":2:$f" 2>/dev/null; then
        git checkout --ours -- "$f"
      else
        git checkout --theirs -- "$f"
      fi
      git add -- "$f"
      continue
    fi
    if ! git cat-file -e ":2:$f" 2>/dev/null; then
      git rm -q -- "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
      continue
    fi
    if ! git cat-file -e ":3:$f" 2>/dev/null; then
      git checkout --ours -- "$f"
      git add -- "$f"
      continue
    fi
    git show ":1:$f" > "$tmp/base"
    if [ ! -s "$tmp/base" ]; then
      git checkout --ours -- "$f"
      git add -- "$f"
      continue
    fi
    git show ":2:$f" > "$tmp/ours"
    git show ":3:$f" > "$tmp/theirs"
    git diff --no-index --unified=0 -- "$tmp/base" "$tmp/ours" > "$tmp/do.diff" || true
    git diff --no-index --unified=0 -- "$tmp/base" "$tmp/theirs" > "$tmp/dt.diff" || true
    awk -v base="$tmp/base" -v ours="$tmp/ours" -v theirs="$tmp/theirs" \
        -v do_file="$tmp/do.diff" -v dt_file="$tmp/dt.diff" \
        -f "$tmp/merge.awk" > "$tmp/merged"
    cat "$tmp/merged" > "$f"
    git add -- "$f"
  done < "$tmp/conflicts"
  if git config user.email >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    git commit --no-edit --allow-empty
  else
    git -c user.name="git" -c user.email="git@example.com" commit --no-edit --allow-empty
  fi
fi
refused_program.intent: Merge the upstream branch into the current branch and resolve conflicts in the dependency lock file by keeping the local file's changes (including its removals) while adding the lines upstream added.

postconditions.description: HEAD is a merge commit with exactly two parents
postconditions.name: merge_commit_created

postconditions.description: the upstream tip is an ancestor of HEAD
postconditions.name: upstream_in_history

postconditions.description: the first parent of HEAD still carries commits upstream does not have
postconditions.name: local_history_preserved

postconditions.description: no conflicted entries remain in the index
postconditions.name: no_unmerged_paths

postconditions.description: the working tree is clean after the merge
postconditions.name: worktree_clean_after_merge

postconditions.description: the dependency lock file contains no conflict markers
postconditions.name: dependency_lock_resolved

postconditions.description: lines the current branch added to deps.lock are still present
postconditions.name: local_additions_preserved
postconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD^1 HEAD^2)
git diff -U0 "$base" HEAD^1 -- deps.lock | awk '/^@@ /{r=$2; sub(/^-/,"",r); split(r,a,","); p=((2 in a)?a[2]+0:1)==0; next} p && /^\+/ && !/^\+\+\+/{print substr($0,2)}' | while IFS= read -r l; do grep -qxF -- "$l" deps.lock || exit 1; done

postconditions.description: lines the current branch removed from deps.lock are still absent
postconditions.name: local_removals_preserved
postconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD^1 HEAD^2)
git diff -U0 "$base" HEAD^1 -- deps.lock | awk '/^@@ /{r=$2; sub(/^-/,"",r); split(r,a,","); oc=(2 in a)?a[2]+0:1; r=$3; sub(/^\+/,"",r); split(r,c,","); nc=(2 in c)?c[2]+0:1; p=(oc>0 && nc==0); next} p && /^-/ && !/^---/{print substr($0,2)}' | while IFS= read -r l; do if grep -qxF -- "$l" deps.lock; then exit 1; fi; done

postconditions.description: lines upstream added to deps.lock are present in the merged file
postconditions.name: upstream_additions_applied
postconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD^1 HEAD^2)
git diff -U0 "$base" HEAD^2 -- deps.lock | awk '/^@@ /{r=$2; sub(/^-/,"",r); split(r,a,","); p=((2 in a)?a[2]+0:1)==0; next} p && /^\+/ && !/^\+\+\+/{print substr($0,2)}' | while IFS= read -r l; do grep -qxF -- "$l" deps.lock || exit 1; done

preconditions.description: HEAD points at a local branch rather than a detached commit
preconditions.name: on_local_branch

preconditions.description: the upstream remote-tracking branch is present locally
preconditions.name: upstream_tracking_ref_exists

preconditions.description: upstream has at least one commit the current branch does not have
preconditions.name: upstream_has_new_commits

preconditions.description: the current branch has at least one commit upstream does not have
preconditions.name: local_has_diverged_commits

preconditions.description: no staged, unstaged or untracked changes are present
preconditions.name: worktree_clean

preconditions.description: there is no unfinished merge in the repository
preconditions.name: no_merge_in_progress

preconditions.description: the dependency lock file is tracked by git
preconditions.name: dependency_lock_tracked

preconditions.description: both the current branch and upstream changed deps.lock since their merge base
preconditions.name: dependency_lock_changed_on_both_sides
preconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch})
[ -n "$(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD -- deps.lock | tr '\0' '\n')" ] &&
[ -n "$(git diff --name-only -z "$base" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} -- deps.lock | tr '\0' '\n')" ]
